items.q: How did Katt Williams cope with an abusive childhood?
items.a: He read adult books from age three and saw himself as **a hero who suffers first**.
He **left home with about $1,200** and rode a truck to Miami.

items.q: Why did he never try hard drugs?
items.a: Homeless former professionals in Peacock Park **scared him straight**.

items.q: What do successful artists secretly wish they still had?
items.a: Their **independence**—the ownership they had before they started.

items.q: How did Katt keep control of his specials?
items.a: He **self-funded them** to choose the director, venue and producer.

items.q: How should you know your worth?
items.a: **Benchmark against your peer group**, like an athlete comparing contracts.

items.q: What does he say about low self-worth?
items.a: **There are no worthless people**—hold your worth deliberately.
